You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain. Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore new technologies, validate technical approaches and identify opportunities for improvement. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least five years of experience in mobile development, with a strong background in native Android and/or iOS development. You have extensive experience with Kotlin and/or Swift. You have a relevant bachelor's degree, for example in Computer Science or Computer Engineering and you are familiar with working in an Agile environment. You have a solid understanding of mobile architecture and software design principles, including clean architecture, object-oriented design, MVVM and/or MVI. You know how to build and maintain modular applications. You have experience with mobile development frameworks and tools such as Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and Kotlin Multiplatform. You are also familiar with unit testing and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and platform-specific design guidelines. You understand what it takes to build reliable, high-performing mobile applications, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation. You have experience integrating web services, cloud technologies, APIs and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. title: Embedded Electrical Engineer - SoM
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the role As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly. Responsibilities Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms. High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity. Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour. Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication. Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs. Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification. Candidate requirements Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production. Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. title: AI Applied Engineering – Platform Engineer Manager
description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Activités et responsabilités</strong></p> <p>Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.</p> <p>Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context &amp; Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.</p> </li> <li> <p>Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li> <p>Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.</p> </li> <li> <p>FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une certification cloud.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour. Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication. Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs. Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification. Candidate requirements Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour. Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium). Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs. Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production. Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. title: PCB Layout Designer / ECAD Engineer
description: ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced and meticulous PCB Layout Designer / ECAD Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the layout process for our high-complexity Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs), directly impacting the performance and reliability of our autonomous mobile robots (ANYmal). You will serve as the bridge between schematic concepts and robust, manufacturable hardware. Beyond layout execution, you will play a strategic role in owning our electronics component library and spearheading our transition to a new, professional ECAD tool. This position gives our electrical engineers the freedom to focus on schematics while you optimize our physical design pipeline for scale. The Market & Our Technology ANYbotics is revolutionizing industrial inspection with ANYmal, our quadrupedal robot designed to navigate the world’s most challenging environments—from offshore oil platforms to complex chemical plants. Our technology integrates advanced robotics software with robust hardware that must withstand extreme conditions, strict EMI/EMC standards, and rigorous safety certifications. By developing highly sophisticated, reliable, and optimized electronics, you enable our robots to operate autonomously where humans cannot. Your Impact Own and manage the entire PCB layout design lifecycle for complex multi-layer boards across our active product lines Take full ownership and management of the ANYbotics electronics component library (InvenTree), ensuring high-quality metadata, symbols, and footprints Lead the evaluation, introduction, and migration execution to a new, industry-standard ECAD tool Conduct rigorous layout reviews for internal electrical engineers and external engineering contractors to maintain impeccable design standards Implement and update corporate EDRC design guidelines for layout routing, stack-ups, and constraints Partner closely with mechanical engineers and Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) partners to optimize Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) for serial and prototype production Your Profile Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related technical field with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in electronics design and layout for industrial applications Expert-level proficiency in at least one industry-standard ECAD software tool (e.g., Altium, KiCad, Cadence) Proven track record of successfully designing complex multi-layer PCBs with strict functional safety and EMI/EMC compliance requirements Deep technical knowledge of signal integrity, high-speed routing, controlled impedance, length matching, and return path optimization Extensive experience navigating DFM/DFA constraints and collaborating directly with EMS partners for hardware productization Dedicated mindset toward component creation, database cleanliness, and rigorous library management Proactive, highly accountable professional who takes clear technical decisions and thrives in a fast-paced environment Bonus Points Experience with rigid-flex PCB designs or layout techniques for wireless technologies Background or strong interest in Explosion-proof (Ex-protection) electronics design for hazardous environments Past participation in a company-wide ECAD tool or library migration project Background in electronics for aerospace, military, or highly ruggedized industrial equipment We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.     Agency Policy:  We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring. Unternehmen erproben im Hub Robotikplattformen, KI-Modelle, neuartige Sensorik und Greiftechnik anhand realer industrieller Anwendungsfälle. Ziel ist es, die flexible Fabrik von morgen zu gestalten. Der Hub verbindet Datenerfassung mittels Motion Capture, Physical-AI-Training und Multi-Robot-Benchmarking. Im Mittelpunkt stehen industrielle Use Cases unter industrienahen Bedingungen, darunter Materialtransport, das Be- und Entladen von Maschinen sowie die Automatisierung von Montageschritten. Wir sind das INC Innovation Center , ein internationales Team, das produzierende Unternehmen dabei unterstützt neue Technologien zu erschließen und innovative Ideen in die Praxis umzusetzen. Für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Hubs suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, selbst anzupacken, technische Lösungen zu entwickeln und die Zukunft der Robotik aktiv mitzugestalten. Ihre Mission Sie bauen die technische Infrastruktur des Hubs auf und machen sie für unsere Anwendungs- und Technologiepartner sowie unser Entwicklungsteam nutzbar. Dabei verantworten Sie das Zusammenspiel von Robotik-Hardware und -Software, Sensorik, Greiftechnik, Datenpipelines und Automatisierungstechnik als integriertes Gesamtsystem. Gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Aachen und Stuttgart leiten Sie die technische Umsetzung industrieller Use Cases. Ihre Verantwortung reicht von der Anforderungsaufnahme über Architektur und Integration bis zur Inbetriebnahme, zum Benchmarking und zur Validierung. Ein zentraler Fokus liegt auf Physical AI: Sie evaluieren und vergleichen aktuelle Foundation Models und Physical-AI-Modelle in verschiedenen Use-Case-Szenarien. Sie bereiten Modelle für konkrete industrielle Use Cases vor, passen sie durch anwendungsspezifisches Training/Fine-Tuning an und validieren ihre Leistungsfähigkeit in realen Robotik-Umgebungen. Ihre Aufgaben Aufbau, Integration und Betrieb der technischen Infrastruktur für Datenerfassung, Modelltraining, Simulation und die Umsetzung realer Use Cases mit Robotik- und Physical-AI-Systemen. Dazu gehören unter anderem Sensorik, Greiftechnik, Motion-Capture-Equipment, Edge-Devices sowie Cloud- und Datenplattformen. Gemeinsame Ausgestaltung industrieller Use Cases mit Industriepartnern zur Erprobung mobiler und humanoider Roboter. Evaluation, Vergleich, Integration und Anpassung von Physical-AI-Modellen und Foundation Models für unterschiedliche Robotik-Hardwaresysteme. Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien, Benchmarks, Pilotprojekten und Validierungen unter industrienahen Bedingungen. Aufbau von Trainingsworkflows für das Erlernen von Bewegungsabläufen durch verschiedene humanoide Robotiksysteme. Die Workflows umfassen reale Datenerfassung/Data-Capturing-Pipelines (z.B. mittels Teleoperationssystemen), Simulation, Datenaugmentation, Modelltraining sowie die Übertragung auf physische Robotik-Hardware. Technische Leitung und Durchführung von Industrieprojekten im Hub gemeinsam mit dem technischen Team in Stuttgart und Aachen. Planung und Steuerung sprintorientierter Arbeitspakete entlang der gesamten Software- und Hardware-Toolchain. Koordination interner Teams, externer Technologiepartner und industrieller Kunden. Entwicklung der technischen Roadmap sowie Identifikation neuer Technologien, Partner und Anwendungsfelder. Beratung von Industriepartnern sowie industriellen Kunden bei der technischen Vorbereitung, Umsetzung und Bewertung ihrer Robotik- und Physical-AI-Use-Cases. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossenes Diplom- oder Masterstudium in Robotik, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Maschinenbau, Automatisierungstechnik, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich. Promotion ist wünschenswert, jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Robotikumfeld; idealerweise bringen Sie mehr als fünf Jahre Erfahrung mit. Besonders relevant sind Bezüge zu Robotik-Hardware, Robotik-Software, Automatisierung, Physical AI, Robot Learning, Sensorik, Simulation oder industriellen Anwendungsfällen. Erfahrung in der technischen Projektleitung komplexer Projekte mit internen und externen Partnern. Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Integration und im Betrieb von Robotik-Infrastruktur oder Automatisierungssystemen. Dazu gehören Kenntnisse über Robotik-Hardware verschiedener Hersteller, Sensorik, Greiftechnik und Edge-Devices sowie über die Integration robotischer Gesamtsysteme. Grundlegende Erfahrung mit ROS 2, Python und Linux sowie mit Simulationstools wie NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab oder MuJoCo beziehungsweise vergleichbaren Technologien. Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen mit Physical AI und Foundation Models, insbesondere VLA-Modellen, sowie mit robotischen Lernverfahren wie Imitation Learning und Reinforcement Learning. Erfahrung im Fine-Tuning von KI-Modellen und im Aufbau von Data-Capturing-Pipelines ist ebenfalls von Vorteil. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise Hohes Eigenengagement, unternehmerisches Denken und die Energie, neue Themen proaktiv voranzutreiben. Freude an einem dynamischen, sich schnell entwickelnden Umfeld und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Fähigkeit, sich eigenständig in neue Technologien und Fachgebiete einzuarbeiten. Offenheit für kontinuierliches Lernen, Experimentieren und Weiterentwicklung im Bereich Physical AI, Robot Learning und autonomer Robotik. Sie möchten Gestaltungsspielraum nutzen, mit dem Hub wachsen und seine Zukunft aktiv mitprägen. Dabei sind Sie Teil eines Teams mit großem Entwicklungspotenzial. Was wir bieten Die Möglichkeit, einen hersteller- und technologieunabhängigen Physical-AI-Hub in Stuttgart von Beginn an aktiv mitzugestalten. Zugang zu mobiler und humanoider Robotik, Sensorik, Greiftechnik, Simulations- und KI-Infrastruktur. Ein internationales Netzwerk aus Industrieunternehmen, Technologiepartnern, Startups und Forschungseinrichtungen. Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung des Hubs: Sie prägen die technische Roadmap, das Team und die Partnerschaften mit. description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. You own your project end to end, from literature review and scoping to implementation and benchmarking, on topics shaped by live projects and production needs. You work in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, on cutting-edge research topics in an emerging defense company where the stakes are high. Implement, train, and benchmark models across topics such as foundation models, knowledge distillation, CNNs, transformers, and embedded models. Explore multi-sensor fusion and the processing of temporal data where projects call for it. Evaluate results rigorously with task-specific metrics to judge relevance and feasibility. Develop proofs of concept and support the transition of promising ones towards production. Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects. Familiarity with computer vision and image processing is a plus, such as classification, detection, tracking, segmentation, depth estimation, or 3D vision. Awareness of model scale trade-offs, from large multi-GPU architectures to small optimized models on embedded platforms. Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly. description: Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter. At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm. Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe . No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer. We are a high-growth European scale-up , backed by €43M from world-class investors , on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here. At our core, we’re a tech company . We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience:  from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair. We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do. What you'll be doing: Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio . This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance. Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers. This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance. What you’ll be up to (some examples): Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online. Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates. Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform. Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution. Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy. This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next. Specifically, you bring: 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred). Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions. Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance. Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting." Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint). Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field. Who this is not for: You prioritize a 40-hour work week : We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week. You prefer your comfort zone : We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here. You prefer to stay high-level : While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit. A steep learning curve feels daunting : We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months. What we offer: Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that. In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam. Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy. Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team. Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe. Our culture (read this carefully) We’re not just building a company, we’re building a  category leader . That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace. Our culture is defined by three things: High ownership People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it. High pace Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection. High standards Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through. At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone . We believe great work happens through close collaboration . We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface. This is a human-sized company . You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together:  from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset. We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here. You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market. Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications. This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams. Your mission Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable. You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it. The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate. What you will do Drive technical co-builds with partners Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept. Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks. Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure. Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories. Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets. Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility. Produce technical marketing content Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives. Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations. Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets. Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember. Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity. Build for the audience Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work. Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype. Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance. Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology. Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication. What we are looking for A strong engineering background The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred. Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems. Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video. A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation. Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value. Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams. The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept. Excellent written and spoken English. This role may suit you if You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing. You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value. You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market. You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems. You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message. This role is probably not for you if Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations. You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it. You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.
